title: 美国足球世界杯后热度延续 门将弗里斯谈主场体验
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: All righty, here we go, last session of the day. We gotta give them a good one, right, Matt?
segments.zh: 好了，开始吧，今天最后一场。我们得给他们来点精彩的，对吧，马特？

segments.en: Last for the best, I think. Yes, exactly, say the best for the last, for sure.
segments.zh: 最后压轴，我觉得。对，没错，好戏在后头，肯定的。

segments.en: So, Matt, this summer, the U.S. and all of North America was captured by the World Cup.
segments.zh: 马特，今年夏天，美国和整个北美都被世界杯点燃了。

segments.en: Have you ever seen the country so engaged and soccer before? I don't think I've ever seen the country so engaged in really a single sport before.
segments.zh: 你见过这个国家如此投入足球吗？我觉得我从未见过整个国家如此投入一项运动。

segments.en: I mean, it was incredible. There's so much unity and energy around one sport for an entire month, it was incredible.
segments.zh: 太不可思议了。整整一个月，围绕一项运动有如此多的团结和能量，太棒了。

segments.en: Was it beyond anything you could have imagined it for? Yeah, I think it's, you know, often you say it's a dream come true and I think that when you really get there,
segments.zh: 这超出了你的想象吗？是的，我觉得，你知道，人们常说梦想成真，但当你真正到达那里时，

segments.en: you realize it's so much more than a dream come true because it's no longer about yourself.
segments.zh: 你会发现它远不止梦想成真，因为它不再关乎你自己。

segments.en: You know, you dream about doing things for yourself and then you get there and you realize very quickly that it's more about representing all the people
segments.zh: 你梦想为自己做事，然后你到达那里，很快意识到更多的是代表所有

segments.en: that are cheering for you and representing an amazing country.
segments.zh: 为你欢呼的人，代表一个了不起的国家。

segments.en: Is that what it felt like? I mean, like, take that first day, that first match in LA, you know, in front of the home crowd, was it,
segments.zh: 是那种感觉吗？我是说，比如第一天，在洛杉矶的第一场比赛，在主场观众面前，是不是，

segments.en: was it the loudest match you've ever been a part of? It was the loudest match specifically because there were so many goals.
segments.zh: 那是你参与过的最吵的比赛吗？那场比赛特别吵，因为进球太多了。

segments.en: It was a bunch of times where it was really loud. But, no, I think the loudest was probably Seattle against Australia, I don't know if you've heard,
segments.zh: 有好几次现场都非常吵。但我觉得最吵的可能是西雅图对阵澳大利亚那场，不知道你听说过没，

segments.en: but the Seattle stadium is known for being incredibly loud.
segments.zh: 但西雅图那个体育场以极其吵闹而闻名。
